study: Frozen full foreground covariance editing of the published single-person mixed trial/Fisher R4 generated JPEG. All 120 personal12 rows for sub-04, sub-05 and sub-01. This is a development test on already examined panels.
source: The ordinary matched H/14 JPEG is shared across all four arms of a recipient. The four physical trials, predicted word, eight permitted off-fold support photos and original 923761 + row diffusion seed come from that participant's frozen packet. The source image is generated. The editor never reads the query photograph or its label.
pose: Continuous min-max-normalized U2NetP saliency on the registered 320-pixel crop. Coordinates are pixel centers in [0,1], x right, y down. Targets contain the center, log(sqrt(trace covariance)), (Cxx-Cyy)/trace and 2*Cxy/trace. These determine the full symmetric covariance. Geometry measurement uses all saliency weights.
transform: Move 80 percent toward the requested centroid, with at most 0.12 of frame size on each axis. Rotate the source covariance eigenframe toward the target via the shortest modulo-pi angle, multiplied by 0.8 and by min(1, source anisotropy/0.15, target anisotropy/0.15). Cap rotation at 30 degrees each way. Along each source principal axis use 80 percent of the log change in standard deviation, capped to [0.75,1.33]. For clipping protection, linearly interpolate the matrix from identity to its requested value as far as possible while every nonzero source-alpha pixel center can fit in the frame with the allowed translation. Choose the permissible center nearest the request. No flips.
compositing: Matting opacity uses smoothstep on the source soft saliency between 0.08 and 0.85, enlarged to 512 with bilinear interpolation. Inpaint the original foreground region from visible recipient background only, using a deterministic multiresolution pull-push fill and a two-pixel dilation. Inverse-affine bilinear resampling transports the source foreground and its opacity. Composite over the filled background and preserve the source exactly outside the union of original and displaced opacity. Neutral re-encodes the same RGB source. All four output arms use identical Pillow JPEG quality 95, subsampling 0.
arms: neutral, prior (eight allowed supports' mean pose), own (recipient's predicted pose), wrong (same predicted word and same fold's recorded donor pose, self for singleton). No support RGB enters the editor.
oracle_before_confirmation: Use all 120 rows of the previously studied registered single-1 four-trial matched reconstruction. Use the actual old query's pose as a scoring-only upper bound. Report resegmented squared center distance, absolute log-radius error, doubled-angle anisotropy-vector error and all-pixel RGB RMSE. Mechanism check requires lower mean anisotropy error and smaller mean center or scale error. No selection or retuning on old or personal12 images. The first tests use synthetic ellipses with known transformations.
evaluation: Once all three image manifests have been sealed, independent scoring can open the personal12 targets. Preserve all queries including singleton donors and misclassified words. The external evaluation protocol fixes DINO, photo retrieval, naming and pixel measurements separately.
